Type: ottoman
Name: Amazon Basics Rectangular Storage Ottoman Bench with Fabric Upholstery, Large - Anchor Grey
Colors: Slate Grey
Materials: Fabric
This product was previously sold as First Hill and now as Amazon Basics Rectangular ottoman bench with lift-open lid and roomy interior storage Durable wood construction with rubberwood feet for strength and stability Linen-look fabric upholstery with a dramatic tufted finish for timeless, sophisticated style Child-safety hinge prevents lid from slamming shut; ideal for an entryway, living room, family room, or bedroom Measures 20 x 51 x 17.5 inches (LxWxH)
